verdict.rationale: Qodo documents automated PR review whose findings are ranked by severity, and it calls out breaking changes, spec gaps, and design deviations. None of the evidence mentions security-specific findings such as injection risks, leaked secrets, or insecure patterns. Configurable finding types and custom rules are adjacent building blocks and do not show that security issues are actually flagged.

support.subject: As a security engineer, reviews flag security problems in the diff — injection risks, leaked secrets, insecure patterns — alongside functional bugs
